scope: Three compact post-P14 regression/survival packages against the current German R124-plus cumulative after the Paper 14 pp.195-203 GDZ600 source-fix candidate. They verify that selected earlier lower-band repairs/no-fix traps survive; they do not apply new TeX patches and do not certify the papers.
publication_decision: Do not upload loose while Noether is at the Zenodo 100-file ceiling. Preserve as compact evidence for the next deliberate Noether source-support/source-fix rollup, or keep GitHub-only if a future rollup supersedes the same survival facts.

files.summary: P01-P08 body/fix-anchor survival package. The post-P14 P01-P08 body span is byte-identical to the prior post-P11 reference span. Result: no new patch needed; previous P01-P08 source-quality caveats remain binding.
files.caveat: Survival/routing proof only. P01/P02/P03/P05 remain inherited survival/context rows; P04 and P06-P08 have stronger targeted prior evidence, but this package is not fresh page-by-page certification.

files.summary: P09 survival package. The post-P14 P09 span is byte-identical to the post-P11 reference span, and the accepted p127 Omega correction/no-fix anchors remain present. Result: no new patch needed.
files.caveat: Survival proof only. P09 source witnesses remain best-available mixed 400/600 ppi, not global high-resolution certification.

files.summary: P10-P12 survival package. It verifies current survival of previously source-confirmed repairs and no-fix traps most likely to be lost or re-asked about, including P10 brace/J-domain/display-dot loci, P11 front-matter comma/source-order loci, and P12 no-patch loci.
files.caveat: No-new-patch package only. P10-P12 full-page sources are mostly 400-600 ppi best-available witnesses, with targeted high-detail crops only for selected dense loci; do not inflate this into strict 650/1000 dpi full-paper certification.

common_caveats: No new canonical TeX body patch is proposed by these three packages.
They are regression/survival evidence after the Paper 14 pp.195-203 candidate, not whole-paper or whole-corpus certification.
They should be folded into a compact Noether rollup only after deliberate pruning because the Noether record is already at Zenodo's 100-file ceiling.
recommended_next_action: Reference from the pending uploads page and current status. Include in the next compact Noether source-support/source-fix rollup only if the same survival facts are not superseded by a later unified German source-audit package.
